## Create a Project

1.  Select a Workspace in the navigation menu
2.  Click on `(First Name) 345 Workspace` in the Spaces panel
3.  Click on `New Project` located in the upper right-hand side

![](slides/images/create-new-rstudio-cloud-project.png){height='350px'}

## Rename the New Project

1.  Click on the project title in the RStudio header
2.  Type a new name

![](slides/images/name-new-rstudio-cloud-project.png){height='350px'}
